description: Answers: does this number match what a live sensor measures right now? Takes a claim with a number (for example 'BTC is $70,000' or 'the Bitcoin funding rate is 0.05%') and compares it with our sensors: BTC/ETH/XRP/SOL price (Kraken hourly close, ECB EUR/USD), BTC funding rate and open interest (Kraken Futures), Bitcoin fast fee (mempool.space), ECB deposit rate, EUR/USD, German day-ahead power price now. Returns match, mismatch or close_not_exact with our value, source and time; with no number in the text it returns our value. A stale sensor is not used for judging; 'not_measured_by_orb_studio' means unverified, not false. Word rules and open data, no AI.
name: check_number
title: Is this number right? Compare a number in a claim with Orb Studio's own sensors
